text:
```yaml
name: Checks
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v3
        with:
          version: 9
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: "pnpm"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      - name: Lint syntax
        run: pnpm lint
      - name: Lint formatting
        run: pnpm lint:format
      - name: Check types
        run: pnpm compile
      - name: Test
        run: pnpm test
      - name: Build
        run: pnpm build
```
